Name: Hodesh
Summary: Wife of Shaharaim, by whom he begat Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcham, Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirma.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:9: Wife of Shaharaim, by whom he begat Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcham, Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirma.
LifeLesson: The mention of Hodesh in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
